title: Bellona Hospitality eyes 100 restaurants, ₹650 crore revenue by FY30
description:
Bellona Hospitality, the food and beverage arm of Phoenix Mills Ltd, is targeting Rs 600-650 crore revenue by 2029-30, driven by its portfolio expansion to 100 restaurants across its brands, a top company executive said.
Bellona Hospitality, which operates 32 restaurants across five cities under five brands, reported around Rs 150 crore revenue in FY26, its Managing Director Prashant Issar told PTI.
The company operates a portfolio of six brands - Ishaara, Dobaara, Cha Hongkong Eating House, Eight, Allora Milano and Legume - across Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad and Lucknow.
For this expansion, Issar said the company has set a capex of Rs 100 crore, which will be raised through internal accruals.
This expansion will mainly be within the five cities where the company's brands are present, besides in places where there are Phoenix Malls.
